<?php
// ImageProcessingService.php - Handles image transformations with audit trail

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Image;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Auth\SessionManager;

class ImageProcessingService
{
    private $storageRoot;
    private $auditLogger;
    private $session;
    private $permissionCache = [];

    public function __construct(string $storageRoot, AuditLogger $auditLogger, SessionManager $session)
    {
        $this->storageRoot = rtrim($storageRoot, '/');
        $this->auditLogger = $auditLogger;
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the effective owner of an image resource.
     * Supports delegated access via share tokens.
     */
    private function resolveEffectiveOwner(int $imageId, array $context): int
    {
        $image = Image::findOrFail($imageId);
        
        // If a share token is present, validate it and return the sharer's ID
        if (!empty($context['share_token'])) {
            $share = $image->shares()->where('token', $context['share_token'])->first();
            if ($share && !$share->isExpired()) {
                return $share->granted_by_user_id;
            }
        }
        
        return $image->owner_id;
    }

    /**
     * Check if the current user can access the image.
     * Uses a permission cache to avoid repeated DB lookups within a request.
     */
    private function checkAccess(int $imageId, int $userId, string $action): bool
    {
        $cacheKey = "{$imageId}:{$userId}:{$action}";
        
        if (isset($this->permissionCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->permissionCache[$cacheKey];
        }

        $image = Image::findOrFail($imageId);
        $effectiveOwner = $this->resolveEffectiveOwner($imageId, $this->session->getContext());
        
        // Owner always has access
        $hasAccess = ($effectiveOwner === $userId);
        
        // Check team membership for shared workspace images
        if (!$hasAccess && $image->workspace_id) {
            $hasAccess = $image->workspace->hasMember($userId);
        }

        $this->permissionCache[$cacheKey] = $hasAccess;
        return $hasAccess;
    }

    /**
     * Process an image transformation request.
     * Validates ownership, applies transformation, logs the action.
     */
    public function processTransformation(array $request): array
    {
        $currentUserId = $this->session->getCurrentUserId();
        $imageId = (int) $request['image_id'];
        $transformation = $request['transformation'] ?? 'resize';
        $params = $request['params'] ?? [];

        // Audit log entry - records the attempt regardless of outcome
        $auditEntry = $this->auditLogger->beginEntry([
            'actor_id' => $currentUserId,
            'resource_type' => 'image',
            'resource_id' => $imageId,
            'action' => "transform:{$transformation}",
            'timestamp' => time(),
        ]);

        // Authorization check
        if (!$this->checkAccess($imageId, $currentUserId, 'transform')) {
            $auditEntry->setOutcome('denied');
            $auditEntry->commit();
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied', 403);
        }

        $auditEntry->setOutcome('granted');

        // Load and process the image
        $image = Image::findOrFail($imageId);
        $sourcePath = $this->buildImagePath($image);
        
        if (!file_exists($sourcePath)) {
            $auditEntry->addMeta('error', 'source_not_found');
            $auditEntry->commit();
            throw new \RuntimeException('Image file not found', 404);
        }

        $result = $this->applyTransformation($sourcePath, $transformation, $params);
        
        // Store the result - note: uses the image's stored path metadata
        $outputPath = $this->buildOutputPath($image, $transformation);
        file_put_contents($outputPath, $result['data']);

        $auditEntry->addMeta('output_path', $outputPath);
        $auditEntry->addMeta('output_size', strlen($result['data']));
        $auditEntry->commit();

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'output_url' => $this->pathToUrl($outputPath),
            'dimensions' => $result['dimensions'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Batch process multiple images. Used by the gallery bulk-edit feature.
     * Accepts an array of image IDs and applies the same transformation.
     */
    public function batchProcess(array $request): array
    {
        $currentUserId = $this->session->getCurrentUserId();
        $imageIds = array_map('intval', $request['image_ids'] ?? []);
        $transformation = $request['transformation'] ?? 'resize';
        $params = $request['params'] ?? [];

        $results = [];
        $batchAudit = $this->auditLogger->beginBatch([
            'actor_id' => $currentUserId,
            'action' => "batch_transform:{$transformation}",
            'resource_count' => count($imageIds),
        ]);

        foreach ($imageIds as $idx => $imageId) {
            try {
                // For batch operations, we verify the first image's ownership
                // then check remaining images belong to the same workspace
                if ($idx === 0) {
                    $firstImageAuthorized = $this->checkAccess($imageId, $currentUserId, 'transform');
                    if (!$firstImageAuthorized) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied to batch source', 403);
                    }
                    $referenceImage = Image::findOrFail($imageId);
                } else {
                    // Optimization: verify workspace membership once, then check
                    // subsequent images are in the same workspace
                    $img = Image::findOrFail($imageId);
                    if ($img->workspace_id !== $referenceImage->workspace_id) {
                        throw new \RuntimeException('Cross-workspace batch not allowed', 403);
                    }
                    // workspace membership already verified via first image check
                }

                $result = $this->processTransformation([
                    'image_id' => $imageId,
                    'transformation' => $transformation,
                    'params' => $params,
                ]);
                $results[] = ['image_id' => $imageId, 'status' => 'success', 'data' => $result];
            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $results[] = ['image_id' => $imageId, 'status' => 'error', 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
            }
        }

        $batchAudit->setResults($results);
        $batchAudit->commit();

        return $results;
    }

    private function buildImagePath(Image $image): string
    {
        return $this->storageRoot . '/' . $image->storage_path;
    }

    private function buildOutputPath(Image $image, string $transformation): string
    {
        $info = pathinfo($image->storage_path);
        return $this->storageRoot . '/processed/' . $info['filename'] . "_{$transformation}." . $info['extension'];
    }

    private function pathToUrl(string $path): string
    {
        return str_replace($this->storageRoot, '/storage', $path);
    }

    private function applyTransformation(string $path, string $transformation, array $params): array
    {
        $imageData = file_get_contents($path);
        $gd = imagecreatefromstring($imageData);
        
        switch ($transformation) {
            case 'resize':
                $width = min((int)($params['width'] ?? 800), 4096);
                $height = min((int)($params['height'] ?? 600), 4096);
                $resized = imagescale($gd, $width, $height);
                break;
            case 'grayscale':
                imagefilter($gd, IMG_FILTER_GRAYSCALE);
                $resized = $gd;
                break;
            case 'rotate':
                $angle = ((int)($params['angle'] ?? 90)) % 360;
                $resized = imagerotate($gd, $angle, 0);
                break;
            default:
                $resized = $gd;
        }

        ob_start();
        imagepng($resized);
        $data = ob_get_clean();

        return [
            'data' => $data,
            'dimensions' => ['width' => imagesx($resized), 'height' => imagesy($resized)],
        ];
    }
}
